note: The reviewed scope of Migration 058 (owner-approved after the feasibility pass): Baseball-Reference team-season bWAR for the four returned players of existing Dodgers trades whose WAR was the only missing fact. They are transaction-return assets, not DISI signing players: no players row is created, their rows carry player_id NULL and join the value views by the asset's bref_id (the 032-035 returned-player pattern). The rows are read from the two archived captures 057 registered; no source row is added. Each player's complete mapped career row set is loaded (the partner team's acquisition-season stint is what places the Dodgers stint after the trade under the existing counterparty-stint rule); the one row excluded is listed with its reason.

players.name: Jon Garland
players.attribution_reason: Tony Abreu (the player to be named later) was the only outgoing asset: SOLE_OUTGOING_ASSET.
players.placement: 2009 ARI is stint 1 (the counterparty's single stint), LAD is stint 2 = cp_ord + 1: the first stint after the 2009-08-31 trade (COUNTERPARTY_STINT_ORDER). The exit is a 2009-11-05 free agency, after the season (OFFSEASON_AFTER_SEASON).
players.not_credited: The 2011 LAD stint (BAT -0.11, PITCH +0.25) is after the recorded 2009 exit and no re-acquisition is recorded: it is outside every control interval, credited to no trade return, and is queued as DODGERS_RETURN_WITHOUT_RECORDED_ACQUISITION.

players.name: Jim Leyritz
players.attribution_reason: Jose Vizcaino and cash (amount not stated) went out: SHARED_PACKAGE_RETURN. The return is package value, never Vizcaino's individual value; CASH_AMOUNT_UNKNOWN stays open.
players.placement: 2000 NYY is stint 1 (the counterparty's single stint), LAD is stint 2 = cp_ord + 1 (COUNTERPARTY_STINT_ORDER). The exit is a 2000-11-01 free agency (OFFSEASON_AFTER_SEASON).
players.not_credited: Every other season is before the trade or after the exit.

players.name: Mudcat Grant
players.attribution_reason: The third hop of the Chico Fernandez chain (Fernandez -> Harkness -> Bob Miller); Miller, John Roseboro and Ron Perranoski went out together and none is a tracked signing. The value is observable in the chain and never attributable to Fernandez.
players.placement: A November acquisition: the 1967 season is before it and 1968 is after it (NO_ACQUISITION_SEASON_DODGERS_STINT). The 1968-10-14 expansion-draft exit follows his single 1968 Dodgers stint (SINGLE_STINT_BEFORE_EXIT).
players.not_credited: Every other season is before the trade or after the exit.

players.name: Zoilo Versalles
players.attribution_reason: The same trade and chain as Mudcat Grant: observable, never attributable to Fernandez.
players.placement: A November acquisition: 1968 is after it (NO_ACQUISITION_SEASON_DODGERS_STINT); the 1968-10-14 expansion-draft exit follows his single 1968 Dodgers stint (SINGLE_STINT_BEFORE_EXIT).
players.not_credited: Every other season is before the trade or after the exit.

excluded_rows.detail: WSA is Baseball-Reference's code for the 1961-1971 expansion Washington Senators. bref_team_code_map has no WSA row (WSH is deliberately mapped only through 1960), and no mapping is added. The row is a non-Dodgers season after his 1968-10-14 exit, so it cannot change his Dodgers transaction value (-1.12 with or without it); loaded with a NULL organization it would only raise TEAM_HISTORY_UNRESOLVED and break the global no-unmapped-organization checks of 032-035.

not_in_scope.note: The other four WAR_NOT_LOADED assets have no verified Baseball-Reference id and no row in either capture. Their blocker is an unresearched exit and no dated no-MLB-appearance observation, not loadable WAR. Their value stays unknown: absence from a file is never zero, and no observation is created.

reviewed_effect.older_view_note: OLDER VIEW != VALUE OF RECORD. The 033 edge view v_trade_realization_edges is not bounded by a later exit, so it shows Garland's return as 0.31 (it includes his 2011 Dodgers stint), and v_player_organizational_realization repeats that figure. The value of record is the 034 interval-bounded value (0.17) that v_player_realized_organizational_value, v_executive_overview and product_player_decision read. The same split already exists for Casey Blake (9.16 in the edge view, 0.94 interval-bounded). No application code reads the 033 figures; 058 does not redesign either view.
